earnings_dossier now caches only a genuinely successful brief: `if brief and not (isinstance(brief,dict) and brief.get('error'))`, so error/cap envelopes aren't cached for 6h.

_social_composite now surfaces spike_pct only when wikipedia is live (_live(wk) and spike is not None), so a stale/non-live stats blob no longer leaks a spike figure that didn't feed buzz.
Moved the _valid_ticker 400 check above the _sec_v2_unavailable 503 check in both intel_filings_v2 and intel_form4_v2 for consistent error semantics.
Added _jarvis_act_refund(n) and call it on aj_run_route's 409 'already running' path so polling a busy Run no longer burns the 10/min budget on no-op refusals.
scanner_profile_save now rejects a non-dict body (400) so a list/scalar can't break save_scanner_profile's dict.update() or corrupt the saved scan config.
jarvis_tts_route: an unknown voice is still 400 only when the CLIENT explicitly passed it; a non-allowlisted voice coming from settings now falls back to 'onyx' instead of 400-ing every TTS call.

exps now coerced via list(ticker.options or []) so a non-sliceable/None options response can't raise before slicing. Date-shape filter left to existing try/except around option_chain.

benchmark_compare port_ret now validates first/last total_value via _num_arg and requires both >0, returning a note on bad snapshot data instead of dividing by a non-numeric/near-zero/negative value.
portfolio_correlation now reports a single 'pairs' list when len(pairs)<=5, so a pair can no longer appear in both most_correlated and least_correlated; >5 pairs keep the original two-bucket output.
portfolio_risk now returns {'note':'risk metrics unavailable for current holdings'} when the per-symbol dict ends up empty, instead of an empty per_symbol that the LLM might misread.
_t_agent_positions now adds 'positions_truncated': len(rows)>30 so the model knows the rows[:30] list is capped.
_safe_int_local now returns min(n,25) for n>0, enforcing the documented max-25 cap on aj_proposals/aj_orders LIMIT queries. Verified clamp.

valid_proposal_args now requires price>0 for add_holding (lo=1e-9) while record_trade keeps price>=0, so a $0 cost-basis holding can no longer be created; a $0 record_trade transfer is still permitted. Verified both branches.

_marks filter replaced with math.isfinite(p) and p>0, also rejecting zero/negative marks, consistent with _order_price's price<=0 rejection.

float(qty)/float(notional) conversions wrapped in try/except returning precise 'invalid qty'/'invalid notional' blocks; notional_usd now tested with 'is not None' so an explicit 0.0 falls to qty=0 and is cleanly rejected by the existing finite/positive check rather than the generic gate-exception path.
is_halted() now returns 'not _trading_enabled_fresh()' (uncached), matching the gate so UI/CLI status reflects a kill_switch immediately rather than up to 5s later.

IPS post-trade check now compares breach identity ((kind, detail) key): blocks if any breach in 'after' is absent from 'before', instead of a pure count delta. Catches a trade that clears one breach while introducing a different one (conservative/fail-closed).
Allowlist carve-out now also permits a risk-reducing BUY-to-cover when _held_qty(symbol)<0 (held short), mirroring the held-long SELL carve-out; other caps still bind.
rearm() 'session_open' failure reason now names the session_whitelist and current session and notes re-arm is allowed only during whitelisted sessions. No control-flow change.

_held_qty now uses (symbol or '').upper() so a None symbol yields a deterministic result rather than an AttributeError swallowed by the broad except.

Kelly avg_win/avg_loss now use float(t.get('realized') or 0) instead of t['realized'], matching the None-safe access used for the win/loss filters two lines above; avoids KeyError being swallowed and neutralizing Kelly.

TP-ladder now records fired rung numbers per symbol in a hidden settings key (__aj_tp_ladder_fired), fires each rung at most once per open position, and prunes the memory for symbols no longer held so a true re-entry resets the ladder. Stops the geometric over-selling on repeat cycles.
Bear-regime branch now LOWERS sell_prob_threshold (base-0.03, clamped 0.30-0.50) so the agent exits more readily in a downturn, matching risk-off intent; was incorrectly raising it.
